title: A sprint item whose goal names article lines is planned after the siblings that reword the same article, and names its facts by text
goal: Planning warns of a committed item whose goal names line numbers of an article that another item of the same sprint touches and rewords first (depends_on), and the goal names those facts by their text or source ids, not by line, so a worker does not anchor or edit the wrong line. In SP-6ukmjucf, ST-ko6bkda5's goal named postgres-column-encryption.md line 39 and linux-nftables.md lines 23, 36 and 52, which ST-vx7kahl3 and ST-suo7g2om had moved to lines 45 and 58 before its claim; the orchestrator had to say so in the brief.
notes: SP-6ukmjucf retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
